title: Split the invoice report into its three jobs

task.text: `ReportService` parses CSV, builds text and delivers it, for three different teams.
Give each job its own type, and leave `ReportService` to coordinate them. `Reports.run(csv, outbox)` must keep returning and sending exactly what it does now.

checks.title: Bad input is rejected and nothing is sent
ReportService neither parses, formats nor stores

hints.text: Ask who asks for each change: the CSV owner, whoever designs the text, whoever runs delivery. Each of those is a reason to change, so each wants its own home.

Move the row loop into `InvoiceParser.parse` and the `StringBuilder` work into `InvoiceFormatter.format`. Delivery becomes the `Sender` interface, injected into `ReportService`, which just calls the three in order.
